person_note: The controlling voice is a nonparticipating third-person narrator with flexible access to characters and background. Diagnostic Goodreads passages q00991, q00996, q01002, and q01009 show third-person scene narration in varied contexts, independently agreeing with the authorized publisher opening and the whole-book POV description. First-person and second-person forms in the remaining quotes are character speech, universal maxims, or unresolved local address rather than sustained base narration. The authorized prose is limited to the opening, but the varied quote evidence and explicit whole-book source resolve that scope limitation; no evidence of sustained first-person, second-person, epistolary, or alternating sections was found.
